shortDescription: UP Police Home Guard Recruitment 2025 Advt. No. 02/2025: 41,424 posts. Download PET / PST admit card, exam schedule, result, answer key and official notices for the 2026 selection stages.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment & Promotion Board released Advt. No. 02/2025 for UP Police Home Guard Recruitment 2025 for 41,424 posts.

The written examination was held from 25 to 27 April 2026. The recruitment process includes written examination, DV / PST and PET / PST stages. Candidates should use the links below for the latest admit card, exam city, schedule, result, answer key and official notices.

Important schedule

  • Application: 17 November 2025 to 17 December 2025
  • Written exam: 25 to 27 April 2026
  • Result: 28 June 2026
  • DV / PST: 13 July 2026 to 07 August 2026
  • PET / PST starts: 14 September 2026

How to download

  1. Open the relevant official link below
  2. Enter your registration number and login details
  3. Download the admit card, notice or result PDF
  4. Check date, venue, reporting time and instructions
  5. Carry a printed copy and valid photo ID

editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I verify UP Police Home Guard PET / PST updates?

faqs.question: Are the dates on this page final?
faqs.answer: No. Treat every date as a prompt to re-check the latest PDF or login dashboard on the official portal.
